data.navTitle: 园边旧木、真菌牌与封闭柜子
data.title: A log left in place

memoryNodes.cue: The group reads a warning label.

data.situation:
Outside the conservatory, a fallen log had begun to decay. A fungus grew along one side. Jo asked why nobody had cleared it away. Ruth said the log was useful to small living things, and the path was kept clear beside it. A sign asked visitors not to taste unfamiliar fungi: some are poisonous. Beyond the sign stood a locked cupboard for gardening supplies, including pesticide. Maya read a label warning that its contents could be toxic; she left the cupboard alone. Jo: Does every fungus harm the garden?
Ruth: No. This one is part of what happens as the wood decays.
Maya: May we handle the supplies?
Ruth: No. We are looking at the labels today, not using the contents.

Beyond the sign stood a locked cupboard for gardening supplies, including pesticide. Maya read a label warning that its contents could be toxic; she left the cupboard alone.
readingBlocks.zh: 玻璃房外，一根倒木开始腐烂，一侧长着真菌。乔问为何没有清走。露丝说倒木对小生物有用，旁边小径仍保持畅通。牌子提醒不要尝不熟悉的真菌：有些有毒。牌后是上锁的园艺用品柜，包括杀虫剂。玛雅看到内容物可能有毒的警告，没有动柜子。

readingBlocks.zh:
乔：每一种真菌都危害花园吗？
露丝：不是。这种真菌参与木头腐烂的过程。
玛雅：我们能碰用品吗？
露丝：不能。今天只看标签，不使用里面的东西。

glossary.note: 此处动词；社会衰败等未计。
glossary.example: The fallen log had begun to decay.

glossary.note: fungus 单数，fungi复数；不属于植物。
glossary.example: A fungus grew along the log.

externalEvidence.definition: an organism of the kingdom Fungi lacking chlorophyll and feeding on organic matter; ranging from unicellular or multicellular organisms to spore-bearing syncytia

glossary.zh: 含有能造成伤害的毒物的；有毒的
glossary.note: 不意味着所有真菌都危险。

externalEvidence.definition: having the qualities or effects of a poison

glossary.zh: 用于防治害虫等有害生物的农药
glossary.note: 原中文杀虫剂较窄；此单位用农药类，非用药指导。
glossary.example: The cupboard held gardening supplies, including pesticide.
glossary.exampleZh: 柜里有园艺用品，包括农药。

externalEvidence.definition: a chemical used to kill pests (as rodents or insects)

glossary.zh: 具有毒性、能造成伤害的
glossary.example: The label warned that the contents could be toxic.
glossary.exampleZh: 标签警告内容物可能有毒。

externalEvidence.definition: of or relating to or caused by a toxin or poison
